Reacher CM Dev 26.11.1-dev.10, a pre-release built from the fork's main.

New since v26.11.1-dev.9:

- Connect without the WireGuard tunnel
- iDRAC 9 remote console works on newer firmware
- iDRAC remote console waits for its one-time login
- Remote console tooltip and SSH button for server management
- Newer session settings in bulk edit
- iDRAC no longer shown as UniFi; server makers' logos for management controllers
- Sessions a phone can't open stay in the list, greyed out
- WireGuard for FTP/FTPS and Server management sessions
- Proxmox VE sessions
- Authenticated organization vault rotations

iPhone and iPad: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/update-feed/apps.json as a source in LiveContainer to get updates.
Full list of changes: https://github.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
